item.title: What makes the Foundation the Foundation?: Re: What makes the Foundation the Foundation?
item.content:encoded:
I feel like there's kind of 2 questions here.

In regards to leadership, there is a hierarchy, it's just not interesting enough to mention in many stories. Think about the O5's (and the Ethics Committee, who have similar power) like the board of a corporation or president of a state, and fill in all the boring jobs beneath them. Site Directors are the next down in power, and there are many stories on the wiki that involve the end of the world that show Sites still independently functioning.

For the essence, I agree with Nagiros that research is a core practice. The Foundation believes in the status quo, and the status quo objective way to understand the world is science. Beyond that, if you learn to understand an anomaly, then it is no longer anomalous (even if you don't plan to let the world know.) I picture the Foundation as being very academic, with scientists working on many different SCPs collaborating and publishing and sharing knowledge. See Kate Mctiriss's articles for a little taste of this.

If you want the super broad answer, the core essence is Secure, Contain, Protect. Secure and Contain refer to anomalies, while Protect refers to anomalies (from outside forces), humanity (from anomalies), and normalcy (from even knowledge of anomalies).

item.title: What makes the Foundation the Foundation?: Re: What makes the Foundation the Foundation?
item.content:encoded:
So what makes the foundation once you strip away the O5 council and the researchers?

In addition to the Council and Research/Development, the Foundation also has a lot of administrative and military infrastructure. The Council is generally understand as kinds of "eyes in the sky", but in their absence each site would exercise regional oversight and probably have the manpower to maintain the status quo. Big picture stuff, like making some world-saving weapon or another, requires some level of comprehensive knowledge of the anomalous and research/development.

If you were to ask me "What is the Foundation's essense?" I'd probably respond that it's their particular dogma. Research and containment, essentially. The Council, researchers, and nearly everything else is built on maintaining a status quo.

item.title: Information on the IS and IS NOT entity from SCP-4840?: Re: Information on the IS and IS NOT entity from SCP-4840?
item.content:encoded:
They are not entities, IS is this universe and everything that exists in it, IS NOT are the impossible concepts that should not be, usually aren't but occasionally are even though they shouldn't, and some anomalies kind of fall in between.

Yeah, after rereading SCP-4840, I think your interpretation is pretty good. After looking over it now, its become clear to me that IS and IS NOT are at least related to the 'Question Entities' from SCP-5935, as they act almost identically - in the sense that they can act and seem alive (like the entity made of names does in 5935, and as both the serpent and his dark brother do) From that, I'd hazard a guess that IS and IS NOT were two questions: "What is?" and "What isn't?" respectively, and the asking of these questions created the universe. Then the books in the old library would be the answers to these questions, but that's just my headcanon.

On Eve, She could be out their somewhere, but that's for other writers to figure out. In terms of the locations for early humans:

  • Lilith - Foundation Containment as SCP-336
  • Adam El Asem - in Titania's Prison1
  • Cain - Foundation containment as SCP-073
  • Able - Foundation containment as SCP-076
  • Seth - On Audapopadopolis as SCP-4840-B

In terms of their descendants, I have no Idea.

Footnotes
1. BTW: It seems that Titania is a fae goddess, given the current draft for the demon hector.

item.title: Information on the IS and IS NOT entity from SCP-4840?: Re: Information on the IS and IS NOT entity from SCP-4840?
item.content:encoded:
First of all, thank you for pointing out this SCP, I found it incredibly interesting as I love the lore of the origins of the SCP Universe, especaily somethign that integrates so many other important SCPs.

Now, as for these "entities" I read it differently. IS and IS NOT are not entitites, they are the truest philosophical dichotomy, more than good and evil, or natural vs artificial. The one true dicotomy is that which IS and that which IS NOT. IS is everything that exists. IS NOT is that which does not exist, which seems to be a smaller category with every entry on this site. They are not entities, IS is this universe and everything that exists in it, IS NOT are the impossible concepts that should not be, usually aren't but occassionaly are even though they shouldn't, and some anomalies kind of fall in between. One example of IS NOT is SCP-3001 Red Reality, the dimension between dimensions. There is nothing there, not even the reality to allow that which is to properly function should an instance of IS fall into the IS NOT. It's hard to comprehend this, but basically Seth is saying that at the beginning of the universe, Adam, Able, Cain, and Seth determined what IS. IS NOT was whatever did not fall under IS. IS is easy, IS NOT is not something any of us will properly understand by its very nature, and even Seth said as much since he was there when the books were written and tried to read them but even he doesn't really get it, or least not in any wya he can properly explain.

BTW: Lilith is also a part of this along with Adam and his sons since she is also Adam's first wife and she is either the mother of the three brothers or her powers produced Eve from Adam who is of the exceptional haplotype that produced a proper human, in which case where is Eve now? Was she mortal or is she still out there somewhere?

item.title: Different Sectors and site specialty's: Re: Different Sectors and site specialty's
item.content:encoded: You can also use the search bar and type in the name of a particular site if the dossier doesn’t tell you enough. That’s what I did when researching Armed Bio-Containment Area-14 for The Drooling Path, and it was very helpful. You can find what other SCPs are contained at a particular place and compare them to yours to get a better feel for where it belongs.

item.title: 682 Destruction Collective Thread: Re: 682 Destruction Collective Thread
item.content:encoded:
OUTCOME ONE (#682 wins) — Murder Lizard shreds the literal stuffing out of Builder Bear, suffering only a few tool-marks on its hide and evolving an immunity to charm by cute-looking anomalies. Foundation puts another addendum in #682's file and re-classifies #1048 as Neutralized; teddy bears are permitted on Site 24 again. All in a day's work!

OUTCOME TWO (#1048 wins) — Builder Bear has somehow gained access to indestructible tools which allow it to use Murder Lizard as a genetic source for an endless army of immortal Predator Teddies. Even if #682 and #1048 collaborated freely, that's asking for an irreversible SK-class restructuring of reality (new dominant life form).

item.title: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is): Re: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is)
item.content:encoded: Given the extremely negative responses to recent attempts to write up the COVID pandemic as an anomaly, it's probably not a good idea to encourage people do so. Members of the SCP wiki community have lost loved ones to coronavirus; attributing that very real life tragedy to a fictionalized anomalous version can come off as incredibly tactless.
